name: tier-mod
description: Tier: the main session manages, helpers do the work. Every hand-off names a model and an effort (max/Fable only after an opus/xhigh failure of that task); web work, big reads and multi-file edits go to tier-mod:reader / tier-mod:editor; a ledger records what each hand-off cost, its check's exit code, and what it saved.

enforce.title: Enforce
enforce.description: Default of the on/off switch: on refuses what the gates catch; off records only. The pane's switch overrides it per user.

readTokens.title: Reading allowance (tokens per message)
readTokens.description: Tokens of tool output the main session may read per user message before results are handed off.

readLines.title: Whole-file read limit (lines)
readLines.description: A Read with no offset/limit of a file longer than this is refused.

editFiles.title: Files edited per message
editFiles.description: Distinct files the main session may edit per user message.

facts.title: Facts in the system prompt
facts.description: auto adds the Tier note to the system prompt (and the full rule when no CLAUDE.md carries it); off adds nothing.
